THE RESEARCH DESK / Search. Connect. Understand.
Type a question below · /help for commands
Follow the question, then follow the evidence.
A useful investigation starts with a precise question. Search for competing explanations, keep track of your
sources, and make the gaps visible.
Gather relevant sources and preserve the context around each claim.
Compare findings across sources. Separate agreement from independent verification.
